skill.name: subject-line-lab
skill.description: Use when the user asks to generate subject line variants, pre-score subject lines, or check truncation and spam-trigger risk. It drafts subject and preheader options, renders inbox previews, flags heuristic risks, and ranks survivors. It does not write body copy, design the test, verify deliverability, or compute SEND quality scores.
skill.summary: Generate and pre-score email subject lines before testing.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

content.value_statement: Weak subject lines waste test traffic and hide the true value of an email offer. This skill creates variants, checks preview risks, and ranks options before Claude, Codex, or Claude Code hands them to testing.
actual_capabilities: Generate 3-8 labeled subject line and preheader variants.
Pre-score subject and preheader length for desktop and mobile truncation.
Flag subject-level spam-trigger patterns using the included checklist.
Count emoji use and apply stricter cold-outbound rules.
Render from-name, subject, and preheader inbox previews.
Produce a ranked survivor list and handoff summary.
limitations: Does not verify SPF, DKIM, DMARC, or inbox placement.
Does not write email body copy or call-to-action text.
Heuristic scores are not final SEND EQS or legal approval.
Needs campaign context or subject candidates for useful output.

use_cases.title: Prepare Promotional Email Tests
use_cases.description: Create offer-focused subject and preheader options, then remove variants with weak previews or risky wording.

use_cases.title: Screen Cold Outreach Subjects
use_cases.description: Check B2B subject lines for emoji use, deceptive prefixes, vague claims, and preview truncation before sequencing.

use_cases.title: Improve Newsletter Open Hooks
use_cases.description: Turn a newsletter angle into clear subject options with matched preheaders and a ranked shortlist.

prompt_templates.title: Score Existing Subjects
prompt_templates.prompt: Pre-score these subject lines and preheaders for mobile truncation, spam-trigger patterns, emoji use, and inbox preview quality. From-name: [brand]. Mode: [promo, cold, or newsletter]. Candidates: [paste].

prompt_templates.title: Generate Fresh Variants
prompt_templates.scenario: Create options from an offer or angle.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate 5 subject line and preheader pairs for this campaign: [offer or angle]. Use [mode]. Label each variant, show preview risks, and rank the best survivors.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Top Candidates
prompt_templates.scenario: Narrow a shortlist before an experiment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these top subject candidates against the same preheader strategy. Show the desktop and mobile inbox preview, flag risky claims, and choose the strongest 3 variants for testing.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Test-Ready Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced handoff to an A/B test planner.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a test-ready subject-line handoff for [campaign]. Include stable variant IDs, angle labels, measured character counts, estimated render risks, spam-trigger flags, cut reasons, open assumptions, and the recommended next skill.

output_examples.input: Promo campaign for a 20 percent renewal offer with three draft subject lines.
output_examples.output: A ranked table of SUBJ-A through SUBJ-C, each with a matched preheader, character counts, preview notes, spam-trigger flags, and cut or advance guidance.

output_examples.input: Cold outbound subject ideas for a finance operations audience.
output_examples.output: A shortlist that removes emoji-heavy and fake-thread subjects, keeps the clearest benefit-led option, and marks any unsupported claim as needs source.

output_examples.input: Newsletter topic about new product workflow tips.
output_examples.output: Five subject and preheader pairs across curiosity, benefit, question, and utility angles, followed by a preview-safe ranked recommendation.

best_practices: Provide the mode, from-name, offer, and any required claim evidence before generation.
Keep preheaders additive so they extend the subject instead of repeating it.
Treat the pre-score as a screen, then run a proper test and deliverability review.
anti_patterns: Do not present heuristic flags as guaranteed inbox placement results.
Do not invent urgency, discounts, statistics, or scarcity to improve a hook.
Do not test variants with multiple differences when only the subject should change.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It prepares subject and preheader variants for review and testing.

faq.question: Can it guarantee inbox placement?
faq.answer: No. It uses heuristic checks and points flagged items to deliverability review.

faq.question: Can it write the full email?
faq.answer: No. It covers subject lines and preheaders only.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Share the offer, audience, from-name, mode, brand tone, and any past subject data.

faq.question: Does it support cold outbound?
faq.answer: Yes. It applies stricter rules for emoji, deceptive prefixes, and unsupported personalization.

faq.question: How does it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Claude Code can use the skill to structure variants, flag risks, and prepare a handoff for test design.
